purpose: A hard cap on how much this gate may grow. The point is not the number; it is that the number cannot rise by accident.
max_invariants_note: Adding an invariant means deleting one or raising this cap. Raising it is a sealed config change, visible in the loud seal delta and in review. Every check that ever suffocated a project was individually plausible; the failure is never one bad check, it is thirty reasonable ones and no mechanism that says stop.
rule: An invariant earns permanence by catching a defect that actually occurred. Until then it is a guess with a diagnostic code.
deleted_2026_08_07: 23 invariants covering dangling config references, workflow reachability, independence membership, empty version pins, the harness command-line family, and the symbolic-tooling family. All plausible, none had ever fired on anything real. The knowledge they encoded is kept in the config notes and skills; the checks come back the day a defect they would have caught actually occurs.

utility.note: Two kinds of invariant, two signals. Firing count is the wrong measure for half of them: a preventive invariant that works perfectly never fires, so ranking on firings alone deletes exactly the ones that are succeeding.
utility.detective: Earns by firing on a real defect. Measured — every firing is recorded in gate-firings.jsonl. Zero firings after long exposure is evidence against it.
utility.preventive: Earns by being tied to a defect that actually occurred and is now unwritable. Recorded once, at creation, with the incident. Zero firings is the intended outcome and says nothing.
utility.the_test: A preventive invariant with no recorded incident is a guess. A detective invariant with no firings after long exposure is a guess that has been given a fair trial.
utility.what_this_cannot_do: It cannot rank two invariants that both earned their place, and it cannot price contributor friction. Those stay judgement. The point is to remove judgement from the one question that kept being answered wrong — does this check do anything at all.
utility.test_for_the_tests: Each invariant carries the exact mutation that demonstrates it. Applying it must fire that invariant; removing the invariant and applying it again must fire nothing. The second step is the real test: it proves the check is load-bearing for its own case rather than incidentally covered by another. The corpus is one reproducer per invariant, so it is bounded by max_invariants and cannot become a growth surface.

deferred_additions.note: Invariants judged worth having, deliberately NOT added yet. Gate size should track reliance, not anticipate it: an invariant added before anything depends on its signal is paid for now and returns later, if ever.
